iboxs31_audio_init.tooltip: Opens I2S (16 kHz stereo), initializes the ES8389 (I2C 0x10) and turns on the speaker amplifier (IO7); volume 80, microphone gain 12 dB

iboxs31_audio_play.tooltip: Plays a WAV or MP3. The SD card is mounted automatically; a USB drive needs IBoxS31_USB started first. In background the program goes on at once; a new play stops the current one

iboxs31_audio_play_folder.tooltip: Sorts the WAV/MP3 files in the folder by name and plays the given one (from 1; past the end it wraps to 1), handy for previous/next

iboxs31_audio_folder_count.message0: number of audio files in %1 folder %2
iboxs31_audio_folder_count.tooltip: How many WAV/MP3 files the folder has (subfolders and hidden files starting with . are not counted)

iboxs31_audio_control.tooltip: Pause or resume playback; stop ends playback or recording and the recording is saved properly

iboxs31_audio_loop.tooltip: When on, a file playing in background starts again at the end until it is stopped or another file is played

iboxs31_audio_state.tooltip: What the player is doing now; "playing" is false while paused; after the end or an error it is "idle"

iboxs31_audio_info.tooltip: Seconds played (recorded, while recording) and total seconds of the current file; MP3 length is estimated from the bitrate, and a recording until stop has total 0

iboxs31_audio_file_name.tooltip: Name of the file playing or just played (without the folder); while recording, the recording file

iboxs31_audio_error.tooltip: Why the last play or recording failed, such as file not found, unsupported format or no SD card; empty when nothing went wrong

iboxs31_audio_record.tooltip: Records the microphone as a 16 kHz mono WAV (about 32 KB per second); 0 seconds records until stop; anything playing is stopped

iboxs31_audio_tone.message0: audio play %1 Hz tone for %2 ms
iboxs31_audio_tone.tooltip: Plays a sine tone on the speaker (board_test uses 1000 Hz for 0.35 s) and continues when it ends; a file that is playing is stopped first

iboxs31_audio_mic_level.tooltip: Peak of the microphone sound, 0–100; talking or clapping raises it. Normally it reads about 32 ms of sound; while recording it gives the recording level

iboxs31_audio_mic_gain.tooltip: Microphone amplification, rounded to the nearest of 3.5, 6.5, 9.5 … 36.5 dB; above 24 dB it clips easily

iboxs31_audio_switch.tooltip: Speaker amplifier: off silences the speaker (saves power, removes hiss); microphone mute: on makes the microphone level 0

iboxs31_audio_end.tooltip: Turns off the amplifier, puts the codec in low power and closes I2S; initialize again to use it
